title: By Him All Things Were Created
summary: The firstborn of creation is also the one doing the creating, exploding with creativity and joy, and looking on it all to say, "This is good."
exhortation: Yesterday we talked about Jesus as the firstborn of all creation. Here he is the one doing the creating: the preeminent heir is making, fashioning and crafting, hard at work.

When the buck stops with you, when you're the one in charge and given ownership, as a CEO or the lead on a project, you bring a different level of dedication and care. You're fully invested. The outcome isn't abstract to you. It's deeply personal, and you put all your might into it, because it's yours. So here we see that all creation, owned by Jesus, was fashioned by Jesus.

On the days of creation, Jesus is exploding with creativity. "Let there be light," and his creative power sets matter in motion and new forms come into being. In my mind's eye I see Jesus with a huge smile as the heir of all things begins to express his immense creative power. Light exists. The heavens exist. He names his creation and separates the waters. I picture him rubbing his hands together with excitement and joy as creation grows: vegetation and plants spring up, the sun and moon begin to shine, the waters fill with living creatures, magnificent birds fill the sky, and creatures cover the land. Again and again he looks at it all and says, "This is good."

Jesus was there at the beginning, creating, making and building with great joy. His handiwork is in every single thing that was made, visible and invisible. What a glorious Savior. What can we do but stand in awe and worship him?
prayer: Lord, it is a wondrous mystery that you would come: the Creator of the universe, who made all things, becoming a creature, clothing yourself in frail humanity to save those who would mock you, curse you, beat you and nail you to the cross, bearing the sins of the very people who put you to death. Thank you for saving us and dying in our place, so that we might be restored, forgiven and made children of God, raised up with you.

Be glorified in our lives today. Set us on the path of righteousness so that your name is lifted up in us. Open our eyes to the opportunities, and give us grace in the difficulties. We thank you in advance, because we know you are already working and you are with us. In Jesus' name, amen.
